_nota: Textos de estratégia (pt, en) mostrados ao abrir um arquétipo (familias) ou uma variação (variacoes). Chaves = slugs do variacoes.json. Escritos em 01/11/2026 a partir das cartas dos consensos (texto Oracle do Scryfall). Variação nova sem texto: o build avisa e a página não mostra nada.

madness: Aggro de descarte vermelho. Mágicas que compram cartas descartando (Grab the Prize, Highway Robbery, Faithless Looting) põem Fiery Temper e outras cartas com loucura em jogo por quase nada, enquanto criaturas que causam dano a cada mágica e queimas fecham o jogo em poucos turnos.

Red discard aggro. Draw spells that discard (Grab the Prize, Highway Robbery, Faithless Looting) put Fiery Temper and other madness cards into play for almost nothing, while creatures that deal damage on every spell and burn end the game in a few turns.
affinity: Artefatos baratos e terrenos-artefato deixam de graça ou quase de graça as cartas com afinidade (Myr Enforcer, Thoughtcast, Refurbished Familiar, Utrom Monitor). O deck despeja a mão cedo, compra muito sacrificando artefatos e usa Galvanic Blast e Dispatch (maestria com metais) como remoção.

Cheap artifacts and artifact lands make the affinity cards (Myr Enforcer, Thoughtcast, Refurbished Familiar, Utrom Monitor) free or nearly free. The deck empties its hand early, draws a lot by sacrificing artifacts and uses metalcraft (Galvanic Blast, Dispatch) as removal.
terror: Tempo azul com muitas mágicas baratas de comprar e filtrar (Brainstorm, Ponder, Thought Scour). Elas enchem o cemitério e barateiam Tolarian Terror e Cryptic Serpent, ameaças grandes por um ou dois manas, protegidas por Counterspell.

Blue tempo with lots of cheap draw and filter spells (Brainstorm, Ponder, Thought Scour). They fill the graveyard and make Tolarian Terror and Cryptic Serpent big threats for one or two mana, backed by Counterspell.
faeries: Fadas com lampejo e voar: Spellstutter Sprite anula mágicas no turno do adversário, Faerie Seer filtra as compras, os ninjas (Ninja of the Deep Hours, Moon-Circuit Hacker, por ninjutsu) compram cartas ao causar dano de combate e Counterspell protege a vantagem.

Faeries with flash and flying: Spellstutter Sprite counters spells on the opponent's turn, Faerie Seer smooths draws, the ninjas (Ninja of the Deep Hours, Moon-Circuit Hacker, via ninjutsu) draw cards on combat damage and Counterspell protects the lead.
tron: Ramp com os três terrenos de Urza (Mine, Power Plant, Tower), que juntos dão 7 manas no 3º turno. Expedition Map, Ancient Stirrings e Crop Rotation acham as peças; depois o deck ganha vida, controla a mesa com artefatos e baixa ameaças caras.

Ramp with the three Urza lands (Mine, Power Plant, Tower), which together make 7 mana on turn 3. Expedition Map, Ancient Stirrings and Crop Rotation find the pieces; then the deck gains life, controls the board with artifacts and lands expensive threats.
control: Controle azul e preto de jogo longo: contramágicas, remoção barata (Snuff Out, Cast Down, Cut Down), compra (Lórien Revealed) e Baleful Strix. Vence com o monarca, Murmuring Mystic e vantagem de cartas acumulada.

Long-game blue-black control: counterspells, cheap removal (Snuff Out, Cast Down, Cut Down), card draw (Lórien Revealed) and Baleful Strix. Wins with the monarch, Murmuring Mystic and accumulated card advantage.
elves: Mono verde de elfos que geram mana (Llanowar Elves, Priest of Titania). Lead the Stampede e Winding Way recarregam a mão, Quirion Ranger desvira as criaturas e Timberwatch Elf ou Nyxborn Hydra transformam a mana e o número de elfos em dano.

Mono-green elves that make mana (Llanowar Elves, Priest of Titania). Lead the Stampede and Winding Way refill the hand, Quirion Ranger untaps creatures, and Timberwatch Elf or Nyxborn Hydra turn the mana and elf count into damage.
rally: Aggro vermelho explosivo: criaturas de 1 mana, Burning-Tree Emissary para jogar duas mágicas no mesmo turno e Rally at the Hornburg e Goblin Bushwhacker para atacar com tudo de uma vez, com ímpeto. Lightning Bolt e Galvanic Blast terminam o serviço. (As poucas listas de Burn do MTGGoldfish entram na variação Mono Red Rally.)

Explosive red aggro: 1-mana creatures, Burning-Tree Emissary to cast two spells in one turn, and Rally at the Hornburg and Goblin Bushwhacker to swing with everything at once, with haste. Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast finish the job. (The few MTGGoldfish Burn lists are part of the Mono Red Rally variation.)
spy_combo: Combo com quase nenhum terreno no deck: Balustrade Spy, mirando o próprio jogador, joga o grimório inteiro no cemitério; então Dread Return (pela recapitulação, sacrificando três criaturas) traz Lotleth Giant, que causa 1 de dano por criatura no cemitério. Criaturas de mana e defensores montam a jogada.

Combo with almost no lands: Balustrade Spy, targeting yourself, puts the whole library into the graveyard; then Dread Return (by flashback, sacrificing three creatures) brings back Lotleth Giant, which deals 1 damage per creature card in the graveyard. Mana creatures and defenders set it up.
bogles: Criaturas com resistência a magia (Slippery Bogle, Gladecover Scout, Silhana Ledgewalker) recebem auras (Ethereal Armor, Ancestral Mask, Rancor, Armadillo Cloak) e viram uma ameaça enorme que a remoção pontual não alcança.

Hexproof creatures (Slippery Bogle, Gladecover Scout, Silhana Ledgewalker) get auras (Ethereal Armor, Ancestral Mask, Rancor, Armadillo Cloak) and become a huge threat that targeted removal can't touch.
ruby_storm: Combo de muitas mágicas num turno: redutores de custo (Thornscape Familiar, Goblin Anarchomancer), rituais (Seething Song, Desperate Ritual) e terrenos que dão mana dobrada abastecem cartas que exilam do topo para jogar (Glimpse the Impossible, Wrenn's Resolve), até fechar com Seize the Storm.

Many-spells-in-one-turn combo: cost reducers (Thornscape Familiar, Goblin Anarchomancer), rituals (Seething Song, Desperate Ritual) and lands that make double mana fuel cards that exile from the top to play (Glimpse the Impossible, Wrenn's Resolve), until Seize the Storm closes it out.
synthesizer: Boros de artefatos: Glint Hawk e Kor Skyfisher voltam para a mão artefatos que compram ou trocam cartas ao entrar (Melded Moxite, Experimental Synthesizer, Lembas) e reaproveitam o efeito, enquanto a maestria com metais liga Galvanic Blast e Dispatch.

Boros artifacts: Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher return artifacts that draw or loot on entering (Melded Moxite, Experimental Synthesizer, Lembas) to reuse them, while metalcraft turns on Galvanic Blast and Dispatch.
gardens: Controle preto e verde de atrito: Khalni Garden e artefatos que compram cartas servem de combustível para sacrifícios que compram (Fanatical Offering, Eviscerator's Insight), muita remoção e Crypt Rats ou Pestilence limpam a mesa, e Troll of Khazad-dûm fecha o jogo.

Black-green attrition control: Khalni Garden and artifacts that draw cards fuel sacrifice-to-draw spells (Fanatical Offering, Eviscerator's Insight), lots of removal plus Crypt Rats or Pestilence clear the board, and Troll of Khazad-dûm finishes the game.
ephemerate: Controle azul de valor com criaturas que fazem algo ao entrar (Mulldrifter, Archaeomancer, Baleful Strix, Augur of Bolas), reaproveitadas com Ephemerate. Contramágicas e remoção seguram o jogo até a vantagem de cartas decidir.

Blue value control with creatures that do something on entering (Mulldrifter, Archaeomancer, Baleful Strix, Augur of Bolas), reused with Ephemerate. Counterspells and removal hold the game until card advantage decides it.
white_aggro: Aggro branco de muitas criaturas pequenas: Battle Screech e fichas enchem a mesa, Kor Skyfisher e Thraben Inspector dão valor, Prismatic Strands evita combates ruins e reforços em massa terminam o jogo.
White go-wide aggro: Battle Screech and tokens fill the board, Kor Skyfisher and Thraben Inspector add value, Prismatic Strands blanks bad combats and team pumps end the game.
wildfire: Jund de artefatos e sacrifício: Refurbished Familiar e terrenos-artefato, sacrifícios que compram (Fanatical Offering, Eviscerator's Insight), Krark-Clan Shaman para limpar a mesa e Cleansing Wildfire, que compra carta e pode tirar um terreno-chave do adversário (como os de Tron).

Jund artifacts and sacrifice: Refurbished Familiar and artifact lands, sacrifice-to-draw spells (Fanatical Offering, Eviscerator's Insight), Krark-Clan Shaman to sweep the board, and Cleansing Wildfire, which draws a card and can take out a key opposing land (such as Tron lands).
ponza: Ramp verde e vermelho com destruição de terrenos: Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl e Wild Growth aceleram a mana, Mwonvuli Acid-Moss e Thermokarst atrasam o adversário, e cascata (Boarding Party, Annoyed Altisaur) e iniciativa (Avenging Hunter) trazem ameaças grandes.

Green-red ramp with land destruction: Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl and Wild Growth speed up mana, Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst set the opponent back, and cascade (Boarding Party, Annoyed Altisaur) and initiative (Avenging Hunter) bring big threats.
turbo_fog: Deck que quase não tem criaturas: anula o dano de combate turno após turno com Moment's Peace, Tangle e outras neblinas, compra muitas cartas e ganha vida, e vence pelo cansaço do adversário.
A deck with almost no creatures: it prevents combat damage turn after turn with Moment's Peace, Tangle and other fogs, draws lots of cards and gains life, and wins by outlasting the opponent.
familiars: Combo azul e branco de loops: Sunscape Familiar barateia as mágicas azuis, Snap devolve criaturas e desvira terrenos, e Archaeomancer e Ephemerate reaproveitam as mágicas, gerando mana, cartas e vida (God-Pharaoh's Faithful) a cada repetição, várias vezes no mesmo turno.

Blue-white loop combo: Sunscape Familiar makes blue spells cheaper, Snap bounces creatures and untaps lands, and Archaeomancer and Ephemerate reuse the spells, producing mana, cards and life (God-Pharaoh's Faithful) on each loop, many times in the same turn.
gates: Midrange com muitos Portais (Gates): eles dão mana de quase todas as cores e Basilisk Gate deixa uma criatura enorme por turno. Criaturas com vínculo com a vida (Sacred Cat, Outlaw Medic) e Prismatic Strands seguram os decks agressivos.

Midrange with lots of Gates: they make almost every color and Basilisk Gate turns one creature huge each turn. Lifelink creatures (Sacred Cat, Outlaw Medic) and Prismatic Strands hold off aggressive decks.
sacrifice: Aggro preto de sacrifício: criaturas de 1 mana que deixam algo ao morrer (fichas, Tesouros) alimentam Carrion Feeder, Bloodthrone Vampire e Mortician Beetle, e Supernatural Stamina e Unearth trazem criaturas de volta.

Black sacrifice aggro: 1-mana creatures that leave something behind when they die (tokens, Treasures) feed Carrion Feeder, Bloodthrone Vampire and Mortician Beetle, and Supernatural Stamina and Unearth bring creatures back.
cycle_storm: Combo de reciclagem: rituais (Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, Songs of the Damned) pagam muitos ciclos num turno, e cada ciclo causa dano com Drannith Stinger; Reaping the Graves (com tempestade) devolve as criaturas para repetir.

Cycling combo: rituals (Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, Songs of the Damned) pay for many cyclings in one turn, and each cycle deals damage with Drannith Stinger; Reaping the Graves (with storm) returns the creatures to do it again.
inside_out_combo: Combo Boros: Tireless Tribe ganha resistência descartando cartas e Inside Out troca poder e resistência, criando um atacante enorme; Escape Tunnel o deixa imbloqueável e Fling é outra saída. Os Eidolons voltam para a mão a cada mágica multicolorida.

Boros combo: Tireless Tribe gains toughness by discarding cards and Inside Out swaps power and toughness, creating a huge attacker; Escape Tunnel makes it unblockable and Fling is another out. The Eidolons return to hand on every multicolored spell.
dredge: Deck de cemitério: Satyr Wayfinder, Town Greeter, Circle of the Land Druid e Stinkweed Imp (dragar) enchem o cemitério, e Dread Return traz Lotleth Giant, que causa dano pelo número de criaturas lá.

Graveyard deck: Satyr Wayfinder, Town Greeter, Circle of the Land Druid and Stinkweed Imp (dredge) fill the graveyard, and Dread Return brings back Lotleth Giant, which deals damage for each creature card there.
glintblade: Midrange branco e preto de artefatos: Glint Hawk e Kor Skyfisher reaproveitam Tithing Blade (o adversário sacrifica uma criatura) e artefatos que compram cartas, com remoção e Refurbished Familiar para o atrito.

White-black artifact midrange: Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher reuse Tithing Blade (the opponent sacrifices a creature) and artifacts that draw cards, with removal and Refurbished Familiar for attrition.
walls_combo: Combo mono verde de defensores: Axebane Guardian e Overgrown Battlement geram mana pelo número de defensores; com Freed from the Real em Axebane Guardian a mana fica infinita, e Valakut Invoker a transforma em dano.

Mono-green defender combo: Axebane Guardian and Overgrown Battlement make mana for each defender; with Freed from the Real on Axebane Guardian the mana becomes infinite, and Valakut Invoker turns it into damage.
infect: Aggro de veneno: criaturas com infectar (Glistener Elf, Blight Mamba, Ichorclaw Myr) recebem reforços baratos (Mutagenic Growth, Might of Old Krosa, Rancor) e proteção (Snakeskin Veil, Vines of Vastwood) para dar 10 marcadores de veneno em dois ou três ataques.

Poison aggro: infect creatures (Glistener Elf, Blight Mamba, Ichorclaw Myr) get cheap pumps (Mutagenic Growth, Might of Old Krosa, Rancor) and protection (Snakeskin Veil, Vines of Vastwood) to deal 10 poison counters in two or three attacks.
poison_storm: Combo de veneno sem criaturas: Infectious Inquiry e Prologue to Phyresis dão marcadores de veneno e as mágicas de proliferar (Contentious Plan, Experimental Augury, Vivisurgeon's Insight) aumentam todos de uma vez, enquanto Weather the Storm ganha vida.

Creatureless poison combo: Infectious Inquiry and Prologue to Phyresis give poison counters and proliferate spells (Contentious Plan, Experimental Augury, Vivisurgeon's Insight) grow them all at once, while Weather the Storm gains life.
devotion: Mono preto de devoção: permanentes com muitos símbolos de mana preta no custo aumentam o dreno de Gray Merchant of Asphodel, e Exhume traz criaturas do cemitério para repetir o efeito. Hoje são poucas listas, todas em Outras.

Mono-black devotion: permanents with many black mana symbols in their cost grow Gray Merchant of Asphodel's drain, and Exhume brings creatures back from the graveyard to repeat it. Few lists right now, all in Others.
slivers: Aggro tribal de Slivers, verde e branco com toques de outras cores: cada Sliver dá algo a todos os Slivers, como +1/+1 (Muscle Sliver, Sinew Sliver) ou voar (Winged Sliver), e Gemhide Sliver faz todos gerarem mana de qualquer cor. Hoje são poucas listas, todas em Outras.

Tribal Sliver aggro, green and white splashing other colors: each Sliver gives something to every Sliver, like +1/+1 (Muscle Sliver, Sinew Sliver) or flying (Winged Sliver), and Gemhide Sliver lets them all tap for mana of any color. Few lists right now, all in Others.

mono_red_madness: A versão mais jogada: só vermelha, com Guttersnipe e Kessig Flamebreather causando dano a cada mágica, Lava Dart e Fireblast para o fim, e Sneaky Snacker, que volta do cemitério quando você compra a terceira carta no turno.

The most played version: mono red, with Guttersnipe and Kessig Flamebreather dealing damage on every spell, Lava Dart and Fireblast to finish, and Sneaky Snacker, which returns from the graveyard when you draw your third card in a turn.
rakdos_madness: Com preto: Kitchen Imp e Alms of the Vein entram pela loucura, Vampire's Kiss drena e cria fichas de Sangue para descartar de novo.
With black: Kitchen Imp and Alms of the Vein come in through madness, and Vampire's Kiss drains and makes Blood tokens to discard again.
grixis_affinity: A mais agressiva: Galvanic Blast e Krark-Clan Shaman como remoção, Reckoner's Bargain para comprar sacrificando, e Myr Enforcer e Utrom Monitor como ameaças.
The most aggressive: Galvanic Blast and Krark-Clan Shaman as removal, Reckoner's Bargain to draw by sacrificing, and Myr Enforcer and Utrom Monitor as threats.
esper_affinity: Com branco, mais midrange: Cryogen Relic, Baleful Strix, Dispatch e Cast Down seguram a mesa, e Glint Hawk e Kor Skyfisher reaproveitam artefatos.
With white, more midrange: Cryogen Relic, Baleful Strix, Dispatch and Cast Down hold the board, and Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher reuse artifacts.
esper_affinity_novice_inspector: Versão rápida de criaturas: Thraben e Novice Inspector criam Pistas (artefatos), Springleaf Drum acelera e Moon-Circuit Hacker e Leonardo entram por ninjutsu.
Fast creature version: Thraben and Novice Inspector make Clues (artifacts), Springleaf Drum accelerates, and Moon-Circuit Hacker and Leonardo come in via ninjutsu.
dimir_affinity: Mais controle: Counterspell, Abjure, Cast Down e Cut Down, com Lórien Revealed para comprar e Gearseeker Serpent como ameaça.
More controlling: Counterspell, Abjure, Cast Down and Cut Down, with Lórien Revealed for card draw and Gearseeker Serpent as a threat.
blue_terror: Mono azul com Delver of Secrets, Cryptic Serpent e Sleep of the Dead (que volta do cemitério) além de Tolarian Terror.
Mono blue with Delver of Secrets, Cryptic Serpent and Sleep of the Dead (which escapes from the graveyard) besides Tolarian Terror.
izzet_terror: Com vermelho: Skred (com terrenos da neve) e Breath Weapon como remoção, e Murmuring Mystic e piratas que dão o monarca para o jogo longo.
With red: Skred (with snow lands) and Breath Weapon as removal, and Murmuring Mystic and monarch pirates for the long game.
dimir_terror: Com preto: Snuff Out e Cast Down como remoção, Sneaky Snacker e Gurmag Angler como ameaças extras.
With black: Snuff Out and Cast Down as removal, Sneaky Snacker and Gurmag Angler as extra threats.
dimir_faeries: A versão mais jogada, com preto: Baleful Strix, Snuff Out e Cast Down seguram as criaturas, e Thorn of the Black Rose dá o monarca.
The most played version, with black: Baleful Strix, Snuff Out and Cast Down hold off creatures, and Thorn of the Black Rose brings the monarch.
temur_tron: A mais jogada: Bramble Wurm e Generous Ent, artefatos como Barrels of Blasting Jelly e Pinnacle Kill-Ship, e Maelstrom Colossus com cascata.
The most played: Bramble Wurm and Generous Ent, artifacts such as Barrels of Blasting Jelly and Pinnacle Kill-Ship, and Maelstrom Colossus with cascade.
4c_tron_ubrg: Com azul e preto: Ghostly Flicker reaproveita Mysidian Elder, Mulldrifter e artefatos que compram cartas, para um jogo longo de valor.
With blue and black: Ghostly Flicker reuses Mysidian Elder, Mulldrifter and card-drawing artifacts for a long value game.
golgari_tron: Versão de artefatos: Golem Foundry cria Golems, Ashnod's Altar e Myr Retriever reciclam artefatos e Pactdoll Terror drena a cada artefato que entra.
Artifact version: Golem Foundry makes Golems, Ashnod's Altar and Myr Retriever recycle artifacts, and Pactdoll Terror drains on every artifact that enters.
ephemerate_tron: Versão de controle: fogs (Moment's Peace), Mnemonic Wall e Ghostly Flicker reaproveitam mágicas, e Stonehorn Dignitary faz o adversário pular o combate.
Control version: fogs (Moment's Peace), Mnemonic Wall and Ghostly Flicker reuse spells, and Stonehorn Dignitary makes the opponent skip combat.
grixis_control: Junta as listas que o MTGGoldfish chama de Grixis Control e Dimir Control; o consenso é azul e preto: Counterspell, Snuff Out, Baleful Strix e Thorn of the Black Rose, com Murmuring Mystic e Plunder the Trollshaws.

Combines the lists MTGGoldfish calls Grixis Control and Dimir Control; the consensus is blue-black: Counterspell, Snuff Out, Baleful Strix and Thorn of the Black Rose, with Murmuring Mystic and Plunder the Trollshaws.
mono_green_elves: A versão padrão: Avenging Hunter (iniciativa), Masked Vandal, Generous Ent e Nyxborn Hydra como saídas para a mana.
The standard version: Avenging Hunter (initiative), Masked Vandal, Generous Ent and Nyxborn Hydra as mana sinks.
mono_green_elves_birchlore_rangers: Mais elfos: Birchlore Rangers e Jaspera Sentinel geram mana de qualquer cor, Elvish Vanguard cresce, e Distant Melody e Wellwisher aproveitam o número de elfos.
More elves: Birchlore Rangers and Jaspera Sentinel make mana of any color, Elvish Vanguard grows, and Distant Melody and Wellwisher use the elf count.
mono_red_rally: Goblin Tomb Raider ganha ataque e ímpeto com artefatos (Clockwork Percussionist, Experimental Synthesizer, Inventor's Axe, Great Furnace), que também ligam Galvanic Blast.
Goblin Tomb Raider gets power and haste from artifacts (Clockwork Percussionist, Experimental Synthesizer, Inventor's Axe, Great Furnace), which also turn on Galvanic Blast.
golgari_spy_combo: Só uns 4 terrenos: Land Grant, Gatecreeper Vine e Sagu Wildling buscam o que falta, e Saruli Caretaker, Overgrown Battlement e Wall of Roots dão a mana para Balustrade Spy.
Only about 4 lands: Land Grant, Gatecreeper Vine and Sagu Wildling fetch what's missing, and Saruli Caretaker, Overgrown Battlement and Wall of Roots provide the mana for Balustrade Spy.
selesnya_bogles: Verde e branco, com Utopia Sprawl e Abundant Growth para a mana e Malevolent Rumble para achar as peças.
Green-white, with Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth for mana and Malevolent Rumble to find the pieces.
gruul_ruby_storm: Verde e vermelho, com terrenos que se sacrificam ou se esgotam para dar mana dupla (Hickory Woodlot, Sandstone Needle) e Manamorphose para trocar de cor sem gastar carta.
Green-red, with lands that sacrifice or deplete for double mana (Hickory Woodlot, Sandstone Needle) and Manamorphose to change colors without losing a card.
boros_moxite: Com Melded Moxite e Sneaky Snacker (volta ao comprar a terceira carta no turno), Pursue the Past e Ragged Short Spear para trocar cartas, e Lightning Bolt.
With Melded Moxite and Sneaky Snacker (returns when you draw your third card in a turn), Pursue the Past and Ragged Short Spear to loot, and Lightning Bolt.
mardu_synthesizer: Com preto: Refurbished Familiar e Black Mage's Rod, e Cleansing Wildfire para comprar e atrapalhar a mana do adversário.
With black: Refurbished Familiar and Black Mage's Rod, and Cleansing Wildfire to draw and disrupt the opponent's mana.
boros_synthesizer: Boros com Experimental Synthesizer, Thraben Inspector e Thraben Charm, mais próxima do aggro de artefatos clássico.
Boros with Experimental Synthesizer, Thraben Inspector and Thraben Charm, closer to classic artifact aggro.
golgari_gardens: A versão padrão: Crypt Rats e Defile, muita remoção e Nihil Spellbomb contra cemitérios.
The standard version: Crypt Rats and Defile, lots of removal and Nihil Spellbomb against graveyards.
food_gardens: Com Comida: Cauldron Familiar volta do cemitério sacrificando Comida (Nutrient Block, Lembas), e Pestilence limpa a mesa.
With Food: Cauldron Familiar returns from the graveyard by sacrificing Food (Nutrient Block, Lembas), and Pestilence clears the board.
jeskai_ephemerate: Com vermelho e terrenos da neve: Skred como remoção, Augur of Bolas para achar mágicas e Murmuring Mystic.
With red and snow lands: Skred as removal, Augur of Bolas to find spells and Murmuring Mystic.
esper_ephemerate: Com preto e terrenos-artefato: Baleful Strix, Dispatch (maestria com metais) e Refurbished Familiar.
With black and artifact lands: Baleful Strix, metalcraft Dispatch and Refurbished Familiar.
esper_ephemerate_contaminated_landscape: Esper com terrenos básicos e Landscapes no lugar dos terrenos-artefato, mais remoção (Snuff Out, Cast Down) e menos artefatos.
Esper with basics and Landscapes instead of artifact lands, more removal (Snuff Out, Cast Down) and fewer artifacts.
esper_ephemerate_thoughtcast: Quase uma Affinity: Thoughtcast, Glint Hawk, Cryogen Relic e Giant's Boulder, com Ephemerate em Baleful Strix e Refurbished Familiar.
Almost an Affinity deck: Thoughtcast, Glint Hawk, Cryogen Relic and Giant's Boulder, with Ephemerate on Baleful Strix and Refurbished Familiar.
mono_white_aggro: Com Battle Screech, Kor Skyfisher, Lunarch Veteran (ganha vida) e Thraben Charm, mais Prismatic Strands e Guardians' Pledge.
With Battle Screech, Kor Skyfisher, Lunarch Veteran (life gain) and Thraben Charm, plus Prismatic Strands and Guardians' Pledge.
mono_white_aggro_martyrs_soul: Foco no número de criaturas: Martyr's Soul (convocar), Salt Road Packbeast e Search Party Captain ficam baratos com a mesa cheia.
Focused on creature count: Martyr's Soul (convoke), Salt Road Packbeast and Search Party Captain get cheap with a full board.
jund_wildfire: Com Writhing Chrysalis (cria Gerações Eldrazi e cresce quando elas são sacrificadas) e remoção preta.
With Writhing Chrysalis (makes Eldrazi Spawn and grows when they are sacrificed) and black removal.
gruul_ponza: A versão padrão, com Writhing Chrysalis e Eldrazi Repurposer gerando Gerações Eldrazi para acelerar.
The standard version, with Writhing Chrysalis and Eldrazi Repurposer making Eldrazi Spawn for extra mana.
simic_turbo_fog: Azul e verde: Arcane Denial, Behold the Multiverse e Growth Spiral, terrenos que voltam para a mão, e Stream of Thought, que pode deixar o adversário sem cartas no grimório.
Blue-green: Arcane Denial, Behold the Multiverse and Growth Spiral, bounce lands, and Stream of Thought, which can leave the opponent with no cards in their library.
sultai_turbo_fog: Com preto: sacrifícios que compram (Fanatical Offering, Eviscerator's Insight), Crypt Rats para limpar a mesa e Portais e Khalni Garden nos terrenos.
With black: sacrifice-to-draw spells (Fanatical Offering, Eviscerator's Insight), Crypt Rats to clear the board, and Gates and Khalni Garden among the lands.
azorius_familiars: A única variação: Snap, Archaeomancer, Ephemerate e Ghostly Flicker, com Mulldrifter e Preordain para achar as peças.
The only variation: Snap, Archaeomancer, Ephemerate and Ghostly Flicker, with Mulldrifter and Preordain to find the pieces.
mono_blue_faeries: Só azul e mais agressiva: mais criaturas de 1 mana com voar (Faerie Miscreant), Of One Mind para comprar e Cryoshatter como remoção.
Mono blue and more aggressive: more 1-mana fliers (Faerie Miscreant), Of One Mind for card draw and Cryoshatter as removal.
snacker_gates: Com vermelho e Sneaky Snacker: Lightning Bolt, Pursue the Past e Writhing Chrysalis, com Basilisk Gate para fechar o jogo.
